ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 34
   C. 17
   D. 66

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

4. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

5. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 29
   D. 3

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 81

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 16

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

13. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 42
   D. 90

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 21

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

18. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

21. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

22. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 36
   C. 5
   D. 13

23. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
